about_short_description.short_description: Haddock develops a B2B SaaS for the restaurant industry that helps to manage cost control with artificial intelligence.

product.name: haddock Platform
product.description: A cloud-based SaaS platform for restaurants to manage cost control by digitizing invoices and delivery notes, tracking ingredient prices, and calculating dish margins.

product.name: Dynamic Recipe Costing (Escandallos Dinámicos)
product.description: Automatically updated recipe costings that reflect the latest ingredient purchase prices to help restaurants monitor margins and adjust dish prices.

product.name: Supplier Price Monitoring and Notifications
product.description: A system that tracks ingredient price changes from suppliers and notifies users when prices increase to facilitate cost management and supplier negotiations.

product.name: Mobile Ordering from Suppliers
product.description: A mobile interface that allows restaurant staff to create and send purchase orders to suppliers quickly and track order status.

identifier.value: Integration with Point of Sale (POS) Systems

product.name: Integration with Point of Sale (POS) Systems
product.description: Connects sales data from various POS systems to haddock for synchronized expense and revenue tracking and margin analysis.
